name: Flames of Sin adds 40% of each auto attack as Fire damage (#265)
contract: The Flames of Sin aura 803422 reads 'Your auto attacks now deal an additional ${$w1}% of the damage dealt as
Fire Damage.' Its effect 0 (BasePoints 39, 40%) names 802850 'Flames of Sin: Deals Fire Damage.' as its
trigger. Purifier's Edge 802019 'Grants Flames of Sin or increases the duration by $802845s2 sec'; helper
802845 effect 1 carries 2999 + 1 = 3000 ms. Purifier's Edge has SPELL_ATTR3_REQUIRES_MAIN_HAND_WEAPON and
SPELL_ATTR3_REQUIRES_OFF_HAND_WEAPON, so the fixture dual-wields and both hands auto attack. The first auto
attacks under the buff must be followed by 802850 hits worth 40% of those swings (floored per hit, at least
2/7 for swings of 5 or more; 60% if a Fire hit crits), and nothing before the grant or after the buff expires.
#265 reported 'AuraScript::GetTarget called in the wrong hook' for 803422: the proc
script's Load read GetTarget, which is null outside effect hooks, so the script never attached and the native
dummy proc cast 802850 at its DBC base value, 1 Fire damage per swing. Ratings remove melee misses, dodges and
parries and the Fire hit's spell miss.

steps.label: SETUP: the off hand holds a weapon
SETUP: no Flames of Sin before the grant
Control: auto attacks without the buff cause no Flames of Sin hit
Purifier's Edge grants Flames of Sin
An auto attack under Flames of Sin is followed by a Flames of Sin hit
DISCRIMINATING: the Fire hits are 40% of the auto attacks they follow
SETUP: auto attacks continue after the buff
No Flames of Sin hit once the buff has expired
